name: Ceglédbercel (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ceglédbercel (a blue shield with a green tree and a yellow fruit) above the name CEGLÉDBERCEL in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
